model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for several conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and utilizes a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 1000. Tick labels are present at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 40 to 65%. A blue solid line with circular markers represents the "FT" condition, starting at 39.3% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to 52.2% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A red solid line with triangular markers represents the "IKE" condition, beginning at 44.3% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to 49.8% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A purple solid line with diamond markers depicts the "MEMIT" condition, starting at 50.3% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and escalating to 55.4% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A brown solid line with circular markers represents the "Base" condition, starting at 42.3% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to 51.9% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A green solid line with square markers represents the "ROME" condition, beginning at 50.5% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to 64.9% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. A tan solid line with diamond markers represents the "MEND" condition, starting at 46.8% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to 49.9% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000.
